description: This Java class 'ShareUtil' provides utility methods for sharing text content via Android intents and extracting shared text from intents, including handling URLs and Markdown link formatting.

classes.name: ShareUtil
classes.description: Utility class for sharing text content and extracting shared text in an Android application.

methods.name: openShareDialog
methods.description: Opens a share dialog with the specified subject and text using Android's intent system.

methods.name: extractSharedText
methods.description: Extracts and processes shared text from an intent, formatting it as a Markdown link if applicable.
